One of the most effective ways for improving the IELTS vocabulary is the using of mind maps. Mind maps have been a useful tool used to build the necessary vocabulary required for your development for IELTS. Mind maps will help you to generate thoughts that are linked to a particular topic and also in quickly organizing ideas. This will be especially useful in the IELTS writing task 2 and IELTS speaking part 2. It is important to understand how the mind map will work to help you improve your vocabulary.

Connection between Mind Maps and Vocabulary

In the IELTS exam you can expect questions based on a variety of topics. Thus it is essential that you must have needed vocabulary that will be good enough to fetch you a higher band score in IELTS. Similarly, getting your preparation with the Casper Academy of Excellence, one of best IELTS coaching centre in Kochi will help you to get desired band scores.

You may not find it easy to construct a mind map. It can be constructed with enough practice. Then the process of quickly brainstorming for the related themes will happen naturally. The idea here is to break the information you come up with this into different logical groups: It will be like connected themes and supporting examples, vocabulary (part of speech).

Some Tips and Strategies in Creating a Mind Map

Here are some tips and strategies from Casper Academy of excellence that you can follow in creating a mind map.

  • Choose any topic that will be comfortable for you
  • Think of ideas that are related to the topic and you are going to write.
  • Pick all those words that will help you to describe your ideas and thoughts.
  • You must know how you are going to connect all the information with the help of some supporting examples.
  • Think of the advantages and disadvantages related to it.
  • You can practice with topics that you can expect in the IELTS exam.
